title: It's Not AI Slop. It's Human Slop.
body: AI trained on sloppy human text and given lazy prompts gives back more slop.
credit: Paola J. Sullivan, Sofia Villanueva, and Mariana G. Rebello

title: The Price of a Like
body: TikTok posts labeled AI-generated got 7-8% fewer likes; the label signals less effort from the creator.

title: Lost Clicks
body: Google users clicked a result link on 8% of visits with an AI summary, versus 15% without one.
credit: Annabel Vu Dang and Lyra G. Toohey
